_specs: The design name comes from the Shopify image filename, the only record of what the print is. Nothing about the artwork is invented.
buyBody: A gold twist running through the shirt, on the blade collar. No buttons, no placket, nothing at the neck to sit crooked.
pieceHeadline: The gold one, without the collar buttons
pieceParas: A twisting gold pattern across the body, on the collar that has no buttons to do up and no placket to gap. It is the most modern-looking thing in the range and the one that reads least like traditional golf kit.
If you like the Gold Dust but not the placket, this is the shirt.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body. The blade collar is half the product — the crop has to include the neckline, and it has to be lit so the absence of a placket is obvious. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
